data.title: Lasers
data.summary: Cryo / electro / light devices · Devices emitting coherent, collimated, monochromatic light that selectively destroys target chromophores.
data.body:
_Also called: LASER - Light Amplification by Stimulated Emission of Radiation_

Devices emitting coherent, collimated, monochromatic light that selectively destroys target chromophores.

## Parts
- Gain (lasing) medium
- Optical resonator - 100% and partially reflecting mirrors
- Power/pumping source (electrical, flash lamp, chemical, diode)
- Cooling system and plume evacuator

## Types / variants
- Solid (ruby, Nd:YAG, Er:YAG, alexandrite, diode)
- Liquid (dye/PDL)
- Gas (argon, krypton, excimer, CO2)
- Vapour (copper, gold)

## Uses / indications
- Hair reduction: long-pulsed Nd:YAG 1064 (dark skin), diode 800, alexandrite 755, IPL
- Pigment and tattoos: Q-switched Nd:YAG 1064/532, ruby 694, alexandrite 755
- Vascular: PDL 585 nm, alexandrite, Nd:YAG, argon-pumped dye, krypton, copper vapour
- Ablative resurfacing: CO2 10,600 nm, Er:YAG 2940 nm
- Psoriasis/vitiligo: excimer 308 nm
- Acne, scars, keloids, warts

## Viva points & tips
- Mechanism: selective photothermolysis; photothermal, photomechanical, photoacoustic effects
- Know terms: fluence (J/cm2), irradiance, pulse duration, thermal relaxation time, spot size
- Precautions: no combustibles, goggles for all, plume evacuator, no reflective instruments
